scripts.prebuild: npm run release:manifest && npm run content:prepare
scripts.build:pages: npm run release:manifest && npm run content:prepare && GITHUB_PAGES=true NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://chenerdongc3.github.io/GotheWord WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build && npm run content:bundle
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/a1-content.test.mjs tests/a2-content.test.mjs tests/b1-content.test.mjs tests/learning-sync.test.mjs tests/analytics.test.mjs tests/release-metadata.test.mjs tests/auth-production-config.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:ssr:unconfigured && npm run test:ssr:configured && node --test tests/integration/supabase-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:ssr:unconfigured: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL='' NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY='' npm run build && TEST_EXPECT_SUPABASE=unconfigured node --test tests/integration/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.test:ssr:configured: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL='https://integration-test.supabase.co' NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY='integration-test-publishable-key' npm run build && TEST_EXPECT_SUPABASE=configured node --test tests/integration/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.content:a1:prepare: npm run content:a1:generate && npm run content:a1:validate && npm run content:a1:report
scripts.content:a2:prepare: npm run content:a2:generate && npm run content:a2:validate && npm run content:a2:report
scripts.content:b1:prepare: npm run content:b1:generate && npm run content:b1:validate && npm run content:b1:report
scripts.content:prepare: npm run content:a1:prepare && npm run content:a2:prepare && npm run content:b1:prepare
scripts.content:check: npm run content:a1:check && npm run content:a2:check && npm run content:b1:check
scripts.content:check-rights: npm run content:a1:check-rights && npm run content:a2:check-rights && npm run content:b1:check-rights
